value_stream.name: Organizational Change Management, Digital Adoption & Transformation Enablement

fields.Owner: OCM Lead / Corporate Comms (links to VS-14.3)
fields.Volume: Per major initiative (audiences: ~6,762 employees, vendors, B2B customers, board)

workflows.name: Change Communications Strategy, Messaging & Channel Plan

Controls: - CTL-633 (ensure controlled execution — Change Delivery, Communications & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-134.2).)
- CTL-633: legal/compliance pre-clearance for sensitive messaging
Cross-references: - links to VS-14.3 (comms), VS-63 (store comms), VS-75 (app), VS-22/VS-100 (legal/compliance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Noise risk**: Comms lost in clutter; mitigated by channel discipline and manager cascade (W4083)
- **Spin risk**: Over-promising; mitigated by honest messaging and Legal/Compliance pre-clearance
System Touchpoints: - Comms platforms (links to VS-14.3/VS-103.1/VS-63); intranet/app (VS-75); engagement analytics (W4091)

steps.activity: OCM/Comms build the comms strategy: the change story/vision, key messages by audience and phase (awareness→understanding→adoption→sustainment), channels (town hall, huddle, app, email, video, store signage), and cadence

OCM/Comms align messaging with corporate comms (VS-14.3) and store comms/task (VS-63), ensure two-way channels (Q&A, feedback), and pre-clear regulatory/legal-sensitive messaging (links to VS-22/VS-100)
OCM/Comms execute, measure reach/understanding, and adjust

fields.Participants: PMO (VS-112), sponsors, function VPs, workforce planning (VS-103.3)

workflows.name: Transformation Roadmap, Sequencing & Change Saturation Management

Automation Opportunity: - Roadmap dependency analytics; audience saturation scoring
Controls: - CTL-633 (ensure controlled execution — Change Delivery, Communications & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-134.2).)
- CTL-633: transformation-board sequencing approval; change-window policy
Cross-references: - links to VS-112 (PMO), W4074 (capacity), VS-07 (retail seasons)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Saturation risk**: Overlapping changes overwhelm audiences; mitigated by saturation monitoring and sequencing
- **Dependency-miss risk**: Sequencing ignores a hard dependency; mitigated by integrated roadmap with PMO
System Touchpoints: - Roadmap/portfolio tool (VS-112); capacity analytics (W4074); culture pulse (W4077)

steps.activity: CHRO/PMO maintain the integrated transformation roadmap (dependencies, milestones, change windows), and sequence initiatives to manage change load (links to W4074)
CHRO monitor change saturation by audience (survey links to W4077, capacity W4074), and re-sequence/defer to avoid overload, protecting peak retail periods (links to VS-07)
CHRO communicate the roadmap so the organization sees the bigger picture and what's coming

fields.Volume: ~200 store managers, DC managers, HQ managers, supervisors

Controls: - CTL-633 (ensure controlled execution — Change Delivery, Communications & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-134.2).)
- CTL-633: manager-cascade completion tracked; manager feedback captured
Pain Points / Risks: - **Un-equipped-manager risk**: Managers expected to lead change without tools; mitigated by the toolkit program
- **Manager-resistance risk**: Managers themselves resist; mitigated by manager-only channels and sponsor action (W4079)
System Touchpoints: - LMS (VS-19.4); manager toolkit portal; HR (VS-103); comms (VS-103.1)

steps.activity: OCM/HR build the equip-the-manager program: manager toolkits (FAQ, talking points, training, FAQs), cascade sessions, and the expectation that managers own local adoption
OCM/HR deliver cascade sessions (manager→team), equip managers to handle team questions/resistance (W4085), and provide manager-only channels for their own concerns
OCM/HR measure manager engagement/effectiveness, support struggling managers, and recognize strong change leaders (links to VS-102)

fields.Owner: OCM Lead / IT Adoption (links to VS-27)
fields.Trigger: Major system/process change (ERP, POS, ecommerce, WMS)
fields.Volume: Champion network (1–2 per store + DC + HQ function; ~250–400 champions)

workflows.name: Frontline Change Champion / Super-User Network Operations

Controls: - CTL-633 (ensure controlled execution — Change Delivery, Communications & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-134.2).)
- CTL-633: champion role scoped; recognition tied to contribution
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-19.4 (L&D), VS-133 W4061 (pilots)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Burnout risk**: Over-using champions; mitigated by scoped role and recognition
- **Tokenism risk**: Champions without real influence/input; mitigated by genuine two-way channel
System Touchpoints: - Champion network tool; LMS (VS-19.4); IT service desk (VS-27); feedback loop (W4091)

steps.activity: OCM/IT recruit and accredit a super-user/champion network (respected frontline peers per site/function), define their role (peer support, feedback, early adoption), and incentivize
OCM/IT train champions early (ahead of general rollout), give them a direct channel to the program team, and use them for pilot feedback (links to VS-133 W4061)
OCM/IT sustain the network: recognition, refresh on change, retire when no longer needed, and capture peer insights

fields.Participants: Sponsor, HR (VS-103), managers, Labor Relations (VS-84 where relevant)
fields.Trigger: Resistance signals (survey, adoption data, manager feedback)

Automation Opportunity: - Resistance-signal detection from adoption/feedback data; intervention tracking
Controls: - CTL-633 (ensure controlled execution — Change Delivery, Communications & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-134.2).)
- CTL-633: legitimate concerns addressed; labor-relations engagement for CBA-impacting change
Cross-references: - links to VS-84 (labor relations), VS-103 (HR cases), W4091 (adoption)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Ignored-resistance risk**: Signals missed until adoption fails; mitigated by continuous detection
- **Coercion risk**: Forcing change without addressing legitimate concerns; mitigated by root-cause diagnosis and good-faith response
System Touchpoints: - Adoption analytics (W4091); survey (W4077); HR case mgmt (VS-103); labor relations (VS-84)

steps.activity: OCM detect resistance (adoption analytics W4091, survey W4077, manager/super-user feedback), diagnose root (fear, capability, process disagreement, trust, overload), and segment

OCM design interventions (targeted comms/training, manager conversation, process adjustment, quick wins, address legitimate concerns), engage Labor Relations for collective-bargaining-impacting change (links to VS-84)
OCM monitor intervention effectiveness, escalate persistent/blocking resistance to sponsor (W4079), and capture lessons (W4096)

Controls: - CTL-633 (ensure controlled execution — Change Delivery, Communications & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-134.2).)
- CTL-633: campaign alignment with comms plan; engagement tracked
Cross-references: - links to VS-14.3 (comms), VS-63 (store comms), VS-75 (app)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fatigue risk**: Too many events; mitigated by campaign discipline and saturation management (W4082)
- **One-way risk**: Events that broadcast but don't engage; mitigated by two-way design

steps.activity: OCM/Comms design change events/campaigns (launch town hall, training-wave kickoff, go-live countdown, recognition), aligned to the comms plan (W4081) and roadmap (W4082)
OCM/Comms execute across channels and sites (200 stores), using champions (W4084) and managers (W4083), and capture engagement data
OCM/Comms measure engagement, adjust, and feed insights to adoption analytics (W4091)

fields.Owner: OCM Lead / IT Service Mgmt (links to VS-27.1)
fields.Participants: IT (VS-27), PMO (VS-112), service desk, champions (W4084), process owners, BCP (VS-26)
fields.Volume: Per major go-live (ERP, POS, ecommerce, WMS, statutory)

Automation Opportunity: - Readiness-checklist automation; real-time adoption/issue dashboard during hypercare
Controls: - CTL-633 (ensure controlled execution — Change Delivery, Communications & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-134.2).)
- CTL-633: readiness gate; rollback plan; hypercare SLA
Cross-references: - links to VS-27.1 (service desk), VS-112 (PMO), VS-26 (BCP), VS-07/VS-08 (store/POS)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Botched-cutover risk**: Go-live disrupts selling/fulfillment; mitigated by readiness gate, rollback, and off-peak cutover
- **Abandonment risk**: Early friction causes users to revert; mitigated by hypercare and super-users
System Touchpoints: - Service desk/ITSM (VS-27.1); readiness checklist; BCP (VS-26); issue tracker; POS/WMS/ecommerce

steps.activity: OCM/IT run the go-live readiness review (technical, training-complete, comms-done, support-ready, rollback-ready per W4078) and confirm the readiness gate (W4073)
OCM/IT execute cutover with on-site/floor-walking support, super-users (W4084), expanded service desk, and real-time issue triage; protect frontline trading (links to VS-07/VS-08)
OCM/IT manage hypercare (intense support window), taper to steady-state, capture issues→fixes, and transition to operations/sustainment (W4092)

fields.Participants: All affected function VPs, OpEx (VS-133), IT (VS-27/VS-113), HR (VS-103)

Automation Opportunity: - Cross-functional dependency mapping; integrated status dashboard
Controls: - CTL-633 (ensure controlled execution — Change Delivery, Communications & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-134.2).)
- CTL-633: cross-functional RACI; end-to-end benefit accountability
Cross-references: - links to VS-112 (PMO), VS-133 (OpEx), VS-113 (EA), VS-103 (HR)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Silo risk**: Functions optimize locally, breaking the end-to-end outcome; mitigated by cross-functional governance and end-to-end benefit tracking
- **Handoff risk**: Gaps at function boundaries; mitigated by RACI and integration points
System Touchpoints: - PMO/portfolio (VS-112); process architecture (VS-133 W4050); EA (VS-113); benefit tracking (VS-133 W4065)

steps.activity: CHRO/PMO establish the cross-functional governance (workstream leads, RACI, integration points) for transformations spanning functions (e.g., omnichannel = stores+supply+ecommerce+IT+finance)
CHRO coordinate cross-functional dependencies, resolve conflicts, manage the people-side consistently across functions, and align with OpEx process change (VS-133)
CHRO ensure end-to-end benefit realization (not silo wins), and report integrated status to the transformation board
